fact: The Ministry of Health's Vital Statistics Report 2023, validated at a meeting on 20 February 2024, reports 2023 births and deaths drawn from the Department of Civil Status register, cross-checked with Seychelles Hospital ward, maternity and mortuary records, Praslin and La Digue hospitals and primary healthcare centres, with National Bureau of Statistics and Civil Status staff as contributors.
title: Vital Statistics Report 2023
